feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: It's Election Day. Here's what you need to know
entry.summary: After a long campaign cycle, it's Election Day in the 2026 midterms. There are thousands of races on the ballot and some are key to deciding control of Congress.

entry.title: A last look at the polls as Election Day begins
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin talks to Christine Matthews, a center-right pollster and president of Bellwether research and consulting, about the last polling ahead of Election Day.

entry.title: Federal authorities investigate cause of deadly plane crash in Florida
entry.summary: Nine people were killed Sunday when a Learjet crashed in South Florida. Federal authorities are investigating the cause of the crash that occurred during bad weather.

entry.title: New restrictions at Texas Tech are changing what professors can teach
entry.summary: The rules have led to changes in course materials, prompted accusations of censorship and fueled pushback from faculty and students, including faculty departures, student protests and a federal lawsuit.

entry.title: 'Messy,' 'divided' and 'scary': swing voters rate the country ahead of Election Day
entry.summary: One last check in with the Swing Shift voters before Election Day. All of them voted for President Trump. Now, they're rating his presidency and deciding who to support when he's not on the ballot.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Control of Congress is at stake as voters head to the polls, President Trump touts his own record in final message to voters, Iran prepares for potential renewed attacks after U.S. midterms.

entry.title: Four Corners flooding complicates voting for some residents
entry.summary: Historically high rainfalls and river flooding hit Colorado, New Mexico, Arizona and Utah for the second week in a row. Impacts, are widespread, some people will have a hard time voting.

entry.title: Connect250 creates a time capsule of life in America
entry.summary: We hear some of the results of StoryCorps teaming up with Morning Edition to connect listeners across America for a series of conversations about the country on the 250th anniversary of its founding.

entry.title: 'Morning Edition' hosts reflect on swing state voters they met ahead of midterms
entry.summary: Morning Edition hosts Leila Fadel and Michel Martin reflect on the most striking people and perspectives they encountered during their travels to swing states ahead of the midterm elections.

entry.title: Netanyahu's fear campaign won large share of support in inconclusive election
entry.summary: Israel's elections were inconclusive, but Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu still won the largest number of votes with a campaign against Arab political parties.
